dct_description_sm: Nine lines of two-dimensional (2D) reflection seismic surveying using Vibroseis vehicles as sources were acquired in the Timmins–Kirkland Lake area of Northern Ontario in mid 2004. The survey was designed to expand the seismic testing westward to Timmins to develop reflection images under the surveyed lines across major structures,stratigraphy and lithology of special interest to economic mineralization.
dct_title_s: Timmins 2D; South Timmins Regional; 2D seismic reflection
